title: 真實搭訕，搭訕181長腿女生丨搭訕丨愛情丨脫單丨情感丨戀愛丨dating in china#shorts

timeline.summary: A camera-wearing man greets a woman at a storefront, says he wants to meet her and compliments her proportions.
The automatic transcript is unreliable, but the visible sequence shows continued conversation followed by both parties handling phones; the Short does not prove a completed contact save.
The man asks whether she is a model; the exchange appears to mention dancing or an occupation, but several replies are too corrupted to state confidently.
He proposes meeting for coffee if there is time. Her response appears to mention having no time today and already having had coffee, but the exact wording and scope of refusal are unclear.
They say goodbye; no later contact, meeting, romantic result or consent to publication is shown.
